title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Copilot explanations of policy changes
notes: claim 57: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing calls the feature optional without evidence of its arrival behaviour, and leaves SCU consumption unresolved even though Microsoft documents consumption across Security Copilot capabilities. Its summary also understates the published licensing model, and its governance text discounts a documented prerequisite for Security Copilot experiences in Purview.

claims.where: rationale: risk; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The feature is read-only and performs no policy edits, rollbacks or approvals.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP' 'policy change' 'Copilot'; DLP policy change insights enable disable PowerShell Set-DlpCompliancePolicy API. Read roadmap and Purview overview; the roadmap describes explanations but does not state read-only operation or prohibit policy actions.
claims.fix: Replace 'read-only explanations' in the risk rationale with 'explanations'. Replace 'so the briefing assumes none' with 'those actions are not described'. Keep the supported statement that the roadmap describes no policy-editing action.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The roadmap description states no action that edits, rolls back or approves a policy.
claims.quote: analyze policy version deltas (pre-update vs. post-update) and produce a structured, human-readable summary

claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP policy' 'change insights' permissions default storage; 'Security Copilot' 'DLP' 'policy changes' license role storage. The roadmap identifies intended audiences but supplies no exhaustive viewer restriction.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of the impact rationale with: 'Low. The roadmap identifies compliance and security administrators as the intended audience for the explanations.' Keep 'end users are not described as affected'.

claims.quote: Select How’s this response? at the bottom of each completed prompt ... Needs improvement - Select if any detail in the results is incorrect or incomplete, based on your assessment.

claims.claim: DLP policies determine protective actions such as monitoring and blocking, and edits to their conditions or scope can change enforcement.
claims.quote: DLP policies monitor the activities that users take on sensitive items and, if the policy conditions are met, take protective actions.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-learn-about-dlp to sources to support the explanation of DLP enforcement.
